I wrote the review to `dictation-v3/read-aloud-next/review.md`, with the verdict `fix`. It has six `[fix]` findings and three `[note]` observations. I judged it from the diff and requirements.md; I didn't open the other module files or the shots.

- **Scope:** only the resume, queueing and turn-taking piece landed. Echo suppression, highlight dropout, karaoke with phrase streaming and tap-to-pause are missing, and nothing in the folder records them as open.
- **Echo risk:** the new auto-resume and "wait for quiet" logic trust the mic level, which the read-aloud voice itself raises.
- **Question detection:** only a trailing "?" counts. A spoken question that Whisper ends with a full stop will be resumed over the incoming answer.
- **Resume control:** the diff only changes the play button's tooltip. No new button was added, and no shot shows the paused bar.
- **Task folder:** there is no `task.jsonl`, so a fresh agent can't see what landed or how the review was answered.

I made no code edits.

I rewrote one item in `review.md`, and one script flag is still open. I left `requirements.md` alone because it's written for agents, not the owner.

- **Rewrote:** I split the 63-word paragraph in item 2 of `review.md` into a short checklist. It ticks (a) resume, queue and turn-taking, and leaves echo, highlight dropout, (c) karaoke follow and (b) tap to pause unticked. The paragraph on why echo matters is now its own short block.
- **Still flagged:** `node Server/text-check.mjs` now reports only "427 words and no picture". `review.md` is a generated review list, so I didn't try to turn it into a picture.
- **Not checked:** I didn't open any page or screenshot, so the three owner questions (status, what was asked, what was delivered) are unanswered.
- **Log:** I added one `rewrote` line to `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.

I've written the review to `read-aloud-next/review.md` with the verdict `fix`: five fixes and four notes. I made no code edits, and I did not run the tests or open the page.

- **Stuck reply:** After a barge-in closes the mic, `speaking()` can stay true on a stale level. The next queued reply then waits forever.
- **Second owner line ignored:** A question asked while the old reply is already paused doesn't drop it. The old reply resumes and talks over the new answer.
- **No `task.jsonl`:** The task folder has none, although the brief says to log progress and review answers there. A fresh agent can't tell what is answered or merged.
- **"No flood" unrecorded:** It is neither built nor listed as open. Queued replies release after 1.5 s, not the 2–3 s asked for.
- **Readme "open" list incomplete:** It omits the later asks: bubble toolbar and voice chevron, replay, the raised mic threshold, and lit words.

The notes cover readme claims about echo that aren't true yet, review-finding references left in the docs, thin shots for the sheet-open proof, and played ids being marked at queue time rather than after playing.

I wrote `review.md` for this task with the verdict `fix`. It has four fixes and four notes. I only read the requirements and the diff, plus two greps. I didn't run the tests or the demo page.

The four fixes:
1. **Skipped replies:** `queue()` in `Recite.js` overwrites `wait_at` when a second reply arrives while the first is held for the owner's speech. Earlier held replies or sentences are never spoken.
2. **Played flag:** `final()` marks a reply as played when it is queued, not when it is read. A reply that is dropped or lost to a reload before it plays is never read, which breaks item 20.
3. **Stale readme line:** The Watch-out section says echo cancelling and text matching are active, but no echo code exists yet.
4. **Over-eager drop:** `drop_heard()` throws away the paused reply and the queue whenever any fresh reply arrives. Requirements say only a new question should do that.

The notes cover a resume test that only checks a stubbed audio element, the resume timer when the mic is closed, an unverified `.attr().tc()` chain in `ReciteBar.js`, and the "no flood" asks missing from the readme's Open section.

I wrote the review to `review.md` in the read-aloud-next folder. The verdict is `fix`. The diff covers only piece (a): resume, queueing and turn-taking. I read the diff and docs only and did not run the tests.

The findings:

1. **[fix] Queue lost on a new reply.** When a reply arrives while the old one is paused by barge-in, `drop_heard()` calls `stop()`, which also discards every reply already queued behind it. The requirements say only a new question should drop the rest.
2. **[fix] "Never starts while I speak" is only stubbed.** The proof replaces `barge.speaking` with a flag. It never drives the real mic-level path the owner asked about.
3. **[fix] Docs carry history.** `doc/architecture.md` and two code comments cite "review finding N" and "an earlier version", which CLAUDE.md law 9 rules out.
4. **[fix] Readme "Open" list is incomplete.** It omits the thinking cue, `read_aloud_hidden`, the async-update line, `replay_audio` and the raised mic threshold. It also doesn't say the no-flood quiet window is still 1.5 s rather than the 2–3 s the owner asked for.
5. **[fix] Task folder can't stand alone.** There is no `task.jsonl` and no outcome line, and `shots/` isn't indexed. The shots show only the bar, not the sheet half open during a long read.
6. **[note] Half-reply after a question drop.** A question drop leaves `this.live` set, so a reply still streaming would be read from its unsent tail only.
7. **[note] 80 ms poll.** `check_wait()` polls every 80 ms against the "stream, don't poll" rule. It's a local mic-level timer, so it's acceptable, but `architecture.md` should say so.
8. **[note] Ear off means no waiting.** `speaking()` requires `barge.on`, so with the ear off a reply never waits for the owner. That looks intended and is worth one line in the readme.
